items.title: Dittophobia
items.summary: Dittophobia is the third story of Tales from the Pizzaplex 8: B7-2 and chronologically the Tales from the Pizzaplex series' 24th and final story.  It was written by Andrea Waggener.

items.title: Nightmare Foxy (Tales from the Pizzaplex)
items.summary: Nightmare Foxy, also referred to as The Fox in the story, appears in Dittophobia, the third and final story of Tales from the Pizzaplex #8: B7-2 as one of the secondary antagonists torturing Rory.  It was built by William Afton.

items.title: Rory (Dittophobia)
items.summary: Rory is the main protagonist of Dittophobia, the third story from Tales from the Pizzaplex 8: B7-2.

items.title: Five Nights at Freddy's in Popular Culture
items.summary: Due to its success and popularity, the Five Nights at Freddy's franchise has gained a colossal number of cameos, references, parodies, and other appearances in popular culture.

items.title: Crossovers
